name: Austerlitz, 2 December 1805
description: Austerlitz, 2 December 1805, from 06:30. Frame 12.8 x 12.8 km (256 x 256 tiles at 50 m) centred on 49.1372 N 16.7620 E, Bosenitz and the Santon in the north to the Satschan and Menitz ponds in the south, Latein in the west to Krzenowitz in the east; heights from EU-DEM 25 m at 5 m a level. Removed as modern: the D1 motorway and I/50, the railways, the industrial estates and every suburb beyond the old village cores. Restored for 1805: the Satschan, Menitz and Kobelnitz fishponds (drained in the 19th century) from their beds in the DEM, the dyke between the Satschan and Menitz ponds, the Sokolnitz pheasantry and castle, the woods west of the Goldbach drawn on the 1806 plans, and the straight post road from the Posoritz post house to Austerlitz.

en.name: Austerlitz, 2 December 1805
en.description: The Battle of the Three Emperors, 2 December 1805, from 06:30: dawn, before the allied columns set off. All four columns stand on the eastern Pratzen, Kienmayer at Augezd, Bagration on the Olmuetz road; west of the Goldbach, Soult's two divisions wait in the fog of the valley bottom and Legrand holds the villages alone. Davout is not here yet - Friant's head reaches the Telnitz lane at 08:00 and Bourcier's dragoons at 08:45, after the night march from Gross-Raigern. 12.8 by 12.8 km at 50 m a tile, with the Satschan, Menitz and Kobelnitz ponds restored and the motorway and railway stripped out. 372 units from Nafziger's orders of battle, each named.

value.title: Davout Comes Up From Gross-Raigern
value.message: The head of Friant's division is on the Telnitz lane after a night march from Gross-Raigern, marching for Sokolnitz.

value.title: Bourcier's Dragoons Close Up
value.message: The 4th Dragoon Division comes up behind Friant on the same road.
